$Comment: A spot a bar panel can sit at: the top-right, above the quest tracker, so that column reads as
one thing. Measured for the wide World panel: pinned to the right edge, it grows LEFTWARD as
columns open and keeps its first column where your eye already is, and with RowsPerColumn 1 it
runs six bars across before it grows downward at all, which is what keeps it clear of the
Position is a corner preset plus pixel offsets from the edges that preset pins. Columns and
RowsPerColumn say how the rows spread out here. Panels lists which panels offer this spot.
LabelKey names it in the HUD settings.
To retune a leaf without copying this file, add an entry keyed 'TopRight' to
mods/ziggfreedcommon/hud-bar-placements.json with only the leaves you want different.
